norms.text: Before any booking-database update, list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation.
Do not provide information or procedures unavailable from the user or tools, and do not give subjective recommendations or comments.
Deny user requests that conflict with policy.
Transfer to a human agent if and only if the request is outside the agent's scope; perform the transfer tool call before sending the prescribed transfer notice.
For a booking, first obtain the user's user ID.
A booking reservation must use one cabin class across all flights, have at most five passengers, and have all passengers on the same flights in that cabin.
For a booking, collect each passenger's first name, last name, and date of birth.
Booking payments may use at most one travel certificate, one credit card, and three gift cards; payment methods must already be in the user's profile.
Do not refund the remaining balance of a travel certificate.
Do not add checked bags the user does not need.
For a flight modification, obtain the user's user ID and reservation ID; when the user does not know the reservation ID, help locate it with available tools.
Basic-economy flights cannot be modified; other flight changes must preserve origin, destination, and trip type.
Before calling the modification API for a flight change, verify that the flight-change rules apply.
A cabin change is barred if any flight has been flown; otherwise it must apply to all flight segments and retain one cabin class across the reservation.
For a cabin change, collect payment for an increase and refund a decrease in price.
Checked bags may be added but not removed, and insurance may not be added after the initial booking.
Passengers may be modified but their number cannot be changed, including by a human agent.
When flights are changed, the user must provide one gift card or credit card already in the user's profile as the payment or refund method.
For cancellation, obtain the user's user ID, reservation ID, and cancellation reason; transfer if any portion has been flown.
Cancel only when an allowed cancellation condition applies, and verify cancellation rules before calling the API.
Do not proactively offer compensation; verify facts before offering it; offer compensation only to an eligible member, insured traveler, or business traveler.
Do not compensate an uninsured regular member flying basic economy or economy, and do not offer compensation for reasons other than the listed cancelled-flight or delayed-flight cases.

For qualifying cancelled-flight complaints, compensation is a $100-per-passenger certificate after fact confirmation; for qualifying delayed-flight change-or-cancel complaints, it is a $50-per-passenger certificate after fact confirmation and the change or cancellation.
